abort.hub_identity_unavailable: Home Assistant cannot verify that the new address is the same hub. Remove and add the integration again, or reconnect the old address first so its hub ID can be learned.
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The config entry is no longer available.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The hub connection settings were updated successfully.
abort.wrong_hub: The address or credentials belong to a different Norman hub.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Norman Gen 1 hub. Check the IP address and network access.
error.hub_needs_restart: The hub's local control service is not responding. Restart the Norman hub, wait for its status light to settle, then try again.
error.invalid_host: Enter only an IP address, hostname, or root HTTP URL without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
error.no_devices: The hub responded, but no rooms or shutter devices were discovered.

user.title: Connect a Norman Gen 1 Hub
user.description: Connect to a Norman Gen 1 shutter hub over the local network.

data_description.host: The hub IP address or local hostname.
data_description.password: The factory password is pre-filled. Replace it only if the hub password was changed.
data_description.app_version: The Norman app version string sent to the hub.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to the Norman Gen 1 Hub
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the local hub password. The factory password is pre-filled.

reconfigure.title: Update Norman Gen 1 Hub connection
reconfigure.description: Change the hub address, password, or app version. The settings are accepted only if the same hub responds.

data_description.host: The hub IP address or local hostname.
data_description.password: The factory password is pre-filled. Enter the configured password if it was changed.
data_description.app_version: The Norman app version string sent to the hub.

init.title: Norman Gen 1 Hub options
init.description: Adjust plantation shutter movement profiles. Selecting a room also applies to its panels; selecting a panel applies only to that panel.

data_description.tilt_open_targets: Treat both end stops as closed and map Home Assistant 100% open to the visual-open louver position.
data_description.reversed_close_targets: Use the position-100 end stop as closed. A safe visual-open target is applied automatically.

cannot_connect.message: The Norman Gen 1 hub could not be reached.

command_not_confirmed.message: The Norman Gen 1 hub did not confirm the shutter command.

hub_needs_restart.message: The hub's local control service is not responding. Restart the Norman hub, wait for its status light to settle, then try again.

invalid_auth.message: The Norman Gen 1 hub rejected the configured password.

session_rejected.message: The Norman Gen 1 hub rejected the control session after it was retried.

unsupported_position.message: This room has no discovered panel levels, so its nonstandard shutter position cannot be controlled safely.

wrong_hub.message: The configured address now points to a different Norman hub.
